top_paper.title: Let's Scale Step by Step: Compute-Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
top_paper.summary: A two-step hyperparameter transfer framework predicts optimal learning rates for large Mixture-of-Experts models by scaling across widths and token budgets, enabling efficient pretraining without costly sweeps.

papers.title: WorldMind: Decoupled Game World Model for State-Aware NPC Behavior
papers.summary: WorldMind decouples game world modeling into state understanding, decision-making, control, and generation layers to enable explicit, state-aware NPC behavior.

papers.title: PhysCaP: Grounding Code-as-Policy Agent with Physics-Informed Exploration
papers.summary: PhysCaP is a physics-informed code-generation agent that actively explores objects to infer hidden physical properties for efficient robotic manipulation.

papers.title: Peer-Voted LLM-Agent Stress Tests Find Feed-Induced Lexical Convergence but No Reliable Matched-Exposure Advantage for Distributed Sources
papers.summary: Peer-ranked feeds of synthetic LLM agents increase lexical convergence but do not reliably produce opinion capture or coordination advantages across model families and topics.

papers.title: Hydra-0: Action Flow for Generalist World Modeling and Control
papers.summary: Hydra-0 uses action flow as a shared visual interface for generalist world modeling and robot control across diverse embodiments and tasks.

papers.title: Partition the Support, Reconstruct the Residual: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Video Generation and World Models
papers.summary: SparsePR accelerates video transformers via response-coupled partitioning and probe-fitted residual reconstruction, reducing attention error at low executed-pair densities with substantial speedups.

papers.title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence
papers.summary: ParaTempo improves parallel reasoning efficiency by using temporal confidence to dynamically prune, retire, and reallocate reasoning branches without synchronization.

papers.title: FlavourBench: Ranking Frontier Language Models with Executable Culinary Ground Truth
papers.summary: FlavourBench evaluates language models on culinary portfolio tasks using executable ground truth, statistical rigor, and fully reproducible verification.

papers.title: Human-Centric Intelligence in the Era of Foundation Models: A Survey
papers.summary: This survey proposes a unified taxonomy and methodological framework for human-centric intelligence across visual, dynamic, and embodied levels within the foundation-model era.

papers.title: UniSpace: Unified Visual Representation and Scalable Multimodal Modeling
papers.summary: A reparameterized pretrained vision transformer unifies semantic understanding, high-fidelity reconstruction, and image generation within a single visual space without requiring a separate VAE.

papers.title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference
papers.summary: A small hybrid language model using sparse attention and short convolutions achieves faster CPU inference and better benchmark scores than larger conventional models despite training on far less data.

papers.title: EviRank: Structured Relevance Evidence for Multimodal Image Re-ranking
papers.summary: EviRank reformulates multimodal image re-ranking as semantic constraint satisfaction by parsing queries into structured evidence packages and verifying candidates via rubric scoring and listwise comparison without training.

papers.title: Every Coin Has Two Sides: On the Dual Nature of Generalization in On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: On-policy distillation transfers reasoning behaviors rather than specific answers, with generalization strongly tied to teacher-student origin alignment and multi-teacher combinations causing capability trade-offs.

papers.title: Let's Scale Step by Step: Compute-Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
papers.summary: A two-step hyperparameter transfer framework predicts optimal learning rates for large Mixture-of-Experts models by scaling across widths and token budgets, enabling efficient pretraining without costly sweeps.

papers.title: OmniAssistBench: Assistant-style Interaction Benchmark for Omni-LLMs
papers.summary: OmniAssistBench evaluates real-time interactive video assistants by reverse-engineering multi-turn interaction videos, revealing that current omni-modal models struggle with visual prompts, context retention, and timely responses.

papers.title: AgentMercury: Your Agent Can Synthesize Verifiable Environments for Business Scenarios at scale
papers.summary: AgentMercury synthesizes scalable executable business environments that serve as generalizable reinforcement learning substrates, improving agent performance across enterprise and out-of-domain reasoning tasks while making environment construction itself learnable.

papers.title: Hadith computational science in the age of large language models: a critical narrative review
papers.summary: Hadith computational science is evaluated as an evidence infrastructure challenge requiring integration of transformer and retrieval-based methods with expert validation and provenance.

papers.title: Towards Faithful Simulation of Human Shopping Behavior
papers.summary: RecVerse is a GUI-grounded agent that uses hierarchical memory and trajectory-level reinforcement learning to simulate realistic multi-turn e-commerce shopping sessions.

papers.title: Graph Engineering in the Era of LLM Agents: From Individual Intelligence to System Intelligence
papers.summary: Graph Engineering organizes multi-agent LLM systems through dynamic graph structures to coordinate specialized agents and manage complex, evolving tasks.

papers.title: CLEAR: Continuous Latent Adapter Routing for Utility-Preserving LLM Safety Alignment
papers.summary: CLEAR uses a hidden-state gate to continuously modulate a safety low-rank adapter, improving LLM safety while preserving utility on benign inputs.

papers.title: InfinityEdit: Infinite Video Editing with a Lightweight Edit-Ignition Adapter
papers.summary: InfinityEdit enables continuous, unbounded video editing by using a lightweight adapter with history, temporal causal, and edit cross-attention modules to extend edits into future streaming frames while maintaining stability.

papers.title: Beyond Correctness: Benchmarking and Aligning Response Behaviors in Hybrid-Thinking MLLMs
papers.summary: Hybrid-thinking multimodal language models suffer from response-pattern misalignment between thinking and non-thinking modes, which is addressed by a diagnostic benchmark and pattern-specific reinforcement learning penalties.

papers.title: Llama-Mobile: Efficient 2.7-Bit Quantization of VLMs
papers.summary: A framework quantizes vision-language models for mobile deployment using self-generated training data and a 2.7-bit format, compressing Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct to 3.7 GB with preserved visual question answering performance.

papers.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
papers.summary: FlowEvo enables large language model agents to co-evolve reusable skills and workflows during inference, improving accuracy and efficiency across diverse benchmarks.

papers.title: TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity
papers.summary: TinyCast is a compact, attention-free zero-shot forecaster that uses spectral period detection and dilated convolutions to emit predictive distributions with minimal parameters and embedded-device compatibility.

papers.title: The Embedder's Dilemma: LLMs Are Better, but at What Cost?
papers.summary: Large language models and dedicated embedding models achieve nearly identical aggregate performance across diverse tasks, but embedding models are far cheaper and faster, supporting a division of labor by task type.

papers.title: τ_0-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
papers.summary: A hierarchical vision-language-action model improves long-horizon robot manipulation by using world-model-guided test-time search to scale computation for high-level subtask decisions.

papers.title: QuoteBench: How Matched Scores Can Hide Command-Path Failures
papers.summary: QuoteBench reveals that execution-boundary parsing errors significantly reduce LLM coding agent success, and disclosing the boundary helps recover performance, showing that evaluation must account for deployment configuration rather than treating matched scores as intrinsic model properties.

papers.title: Hierarchical Self-Improvement: A Framework for Task-Specific Evolvable Agent Harnesses
papers.summary: Hierarchical Self-Improvement evolves task-specific execution harnesses for frozen LLM agents via hierarchical self-modification, yielding substantial gains on moderate tasks while being bounded by feedback quality and backbone limits.

papers.title: GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: GOAG is an object-agnostic deep generative grasp planner that learns a gripper-specific contact surface distribution to sample valid grasps for unseen objects without object-specific training.

papers.title: CoToGrasp: Contact-Topology-Conditioned Dexterous Grasp Synthesis via Canonical Workspace Learning
papers.summary: CoToGrasp is a generative framework that synthesizes diverse, stable grasps conditioned on specific contact topologies using an object-agnostic, gripper-centric workspace for zero-shot generalization.
